card.name: Small words before how a finding is detected
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, on, of, at, during, 's) right before a clinical exam, test or visit that reveals a condition. Seen in descriptions of how a condition is found or diagnosed.

modes.label: Diagnosis setting words
modes.description: Article or preposition just before a routine visit or procedure where a condition is picked up.
modes.example: Sotos syndrome is most often diagnosed at birth or during<< a>> routine baby clinic visit.

modes.label: Incidental finding
modes.description: The word on after identified incidentally, leading into endoscopy.
modes.example: fundic gland polyps were identified incidentally<< on>> endoscopy.

modes.label: Exam or X-ray phrasing
modes.description: Preposition after an exam or X-ray noun, leading into who or when it is done.
modes.example: A complete medical history and physical examination<< of>> both partners is essential.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the mention of an exam, scan or visit that uncovers a condition.
